== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Captain Tommison is a [[Navigator captain]] who commands the vessel known as [[The Reliable]], a ship described as resembling an animated conch shell. His ship became stuck near a [[roaming island]] only one week after departing from the Capital, appearing as though it had been grounded for years due to the heavy growth of vines and trees around it. Physically, Tommison is characterized by a large build, a long gray mustache, and traditional navy blue [[Navigator]] attire consisting of a bicorn hat and matching jacket. He is known for speaking in a loud, authoritative manner, though he can also be quite blustery and hesitant when faced with difficult decisions. As a [[Navigator]], he is bound to his ship and has significant experience interacting with [[Soulbound]] individuals. His life ended in a suspicious explosion involving Alchemical munitions{{!}}alchemical munitions while he was alone in a tower, an event that some suggest may have been a mistake made during the preparation of explosives.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As the captain of [[The Reliable]], Tommison served as a [[Navigator captain]]. He was assigned the specific task of delivering a crown to the [[Sleepless]] [[cabal]]. During his service, he was also involved in packaging Alchemical munitions{{!}}alchemical munitions. Ultimately, Tommison and his entire crew met their deaths under mysterious circumstances related to the [[Elders]].}}
